title: Cosmo: a Flow run waits on the Flows guide, and a one-off setting stays one-off
description: Live 2026-10-29: Cosmo filled Video Edit's look box with the whole edit prompt (with a picture it holds only corrections) and ran every Video Edit at 1080p because Fabio asked for 1080p once and Cosmo noted it as standing. The 'read app:flows first' rule had no gate.
